description:
Confirm a single domain's registrability and price. The definitive availability check for one domain.

Related: bulk_available, whois, monitor.
name: available

price.description: Registration price with currency (e.g., '9.99 USD'). Only present when status=available.

status.description: Domain status: available = registrable, registered = taken, expiring = in the expiration pipeline, reserved = registry-reserved, invalid = malformed input, unknown = inconclusive

title: Domain Availability Check
